description: This file implements the core client-side routing logic for Next.js, including route navigation, prefetching, error handling, and URL management.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Main class managing client-side routing, navigation, data fetching, and error handling in Next.js.

methods.name: getRouteInfo
methods.description: Fetches component and data for a given route, handling static and server data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates the router state with new route data and triggers notification.

methods.name: beforePopState
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute before a popstate event triggers route change.

methods.name: onlyAHashChange
methods.description: Checks if the URL change is only a hash fragment change.

methods.name: scrollToHash
methods.description: Scrolls to the element specified by the URL hash.

methods.name: urlIsNew
methods.description: Determines if the new URL differs from the current asPath.

methods.name: prefetch
methods.description: Preloads page code and data for faster client-side navigation.

methods.name: _getData
methods.description: Wraps data fetching functions with cancellation support.

methods.name: _getStaticData
methods.description: Retrieves static data, utilizing cache in production.

methods.name: getInitialProps
methods.description: Executes getInitialProps for a component during route change.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Emits route change events to subscribers.
